hero.label: Empathy Spectrum
hero.title:
Understand another,
protect yourself.
hero.description_1: Empathy is not just a nice feeling. It is a skill with three levels: cognitive (understanding), affective (feeling), and moral (caring).
hero.description_2: But warning: too much compassion without boundaries leads to burnout.

cognitive.title: Cognitive
cognitive.desc: Ability to put oneself in another's position.

questions.1: I easily understand another's point of view, even if I disagree.
questions.2: Other people's sadness infects me easily.
questions.3: I feel a strong desire to help when I see injustice.
questions.4: I can predict how someone will react to news.
questions.5: I cry easily in movies or watching news.
questions.6: I intervene in a situation if I see someone being treated badly.

results.disclaimer: This is not a clinical diagnosis.

balanced.title: Balanced Helper
balanced.description: You have a healthy balance between understanding and feeling. You know how to help without burning out.

cognitive.title: Analytical Observer
cognitive.description: You understand motives brilliantly, but do not drown in others' emotions. Cool head in a crisis.

affective.title: Feeling Heart
affective.description: You live strongly along. Remember to protect yourself from 'compassion fatigue'.
